title: Order lines that don't track the source.
tagline: Your own backend, used as a source.

steps.comment: # snapshot it onto an order line via a self: source — copy name + price
steps.command:
skeem create order_lines --order_ref INV-1042 --qty 2 \
  --enrich "self:products?sku=WIDGET-9" --map name=product_name --map price=unit_price --json
steps.note: self: is just a source pointing back at your own backend.

steps.comment: # …but the order line kept its point-in-time copy
steps.note: Invoices and quotes should NOT track the source — deliberate denormalization, with provenance recording where it came from.
